source.title: 3x3x3 With Feet solving with a non-official Stackmat
source.content: One competitor was found to be using a non-official Stackmat timer, which wasn't provided by the organization team for the 3x3x3 With Feet event, and it was granted an extra attempt. It was decided that the organization team is responsible to provide the competition equipment, and the result of the extra attempt was accepted.

translation.title: 三阶脚拧使用非官方 Stackmat 计时器
translation.content: 发现一名选手使用非官方 Stackmat 计时器进行三阶脚拧；该计时器并非组织团队提供。现场给予了额外尝试。裁定认为，提供比赛器材是组织团队的责任，并接受了额外尝试的成绩。
